{{Top|leg}}
'''The Pit''' was the name given by the locals to the deep pit on [[Aargonar 3]] which was home to the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] most well known [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] and was located very close to the [[Aargonar 3 rebel base]]. Many believed this to be the only sarlacc on the moon, however there were in fact several others in more isolated parts of this world.
